package teacherdialog

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

// OnboardingCoordinator is the dark S5 convergence point. It does not own a
// second conversation API: it receives the durable Dialog v2 job already
// admitted by S1/S2. The action branch is deterministic and makes zero AI
// calls; an attached text turn uses the one typed S4 semantic execution and
// never leaks into the generic teacher.response prompt.
type OnboardingCoordinator struct {
	Jobs                  repository.TeacherDialogJob
	Turns                 repository.TeacherOnboardingTurnStore
	Receipts              repository.OnboardingActionReceiptLookup
	StudentTurns          repository.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnGateway
	Students              repository.StudentOnboardingGateway
	Readiness             repository.TeacherLearningReadinessResolver
	Semantic              repository.TeacherOnboardingSemanticInterpreter
	DialogReader          repository.DialogRequestContextReader
	Appender              repository.DialogTeacherCoordinatedResponseAppender
	Deliveries            repository.TeacherOnboardingDeliveryStore
	ProductResponses      repository.TeacherProductAwareOnboardingResponseStore
	Handoffs              repository.TeacherOnboardingHandoffStore
	PlannerHandoffEnabled bool
	Clock                 Clock
}

// errKnownOnboardingStale is produced only after Dialog context was read and
// its source identity/reply/status were verified. It is intentionally private:
// transport, malformed-context and UI-digest failures must retry/block rather
// than being converted into a locally generated stale warning.
var errKnownOnboardingStale = errors.New("known onboarding prompt is stale")

func (coordinator OnboardingCoordinator) Process(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob) (bool, error) {
	if !coordinator.valid() {
		return true, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	if job.Request.ActionReceiptID != "" {
		if !eligibleS5OnboardingRequest(job.Request) {
			return true, domain.ErrTeacherDialogCanonicalActionBlocked
		}
		return true, coordinator.processAction(ctx, job)
	}
	if !eligibleS5OnboardingRequest(job.Request) {
		return false, nil
	}
	interaction, policyVersion, found, err := coordinator.currentInteraction(ctx, job)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, errKnownOnboardingStale) {
			return coordinator.handleKnownStaleText(ctx, job)
		}
		return true, err
	}
	if !found {
		return coordinator.handleKnownStaleText(ctx, job)
	}
	return true, coordinator.processText(ctx, job, interaction, policyVersion)
}

func (coordinator OnboardingCoordinator) handleKnownStaleText(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob) (bool, error) {
	interaction, known, err := coordinator.Turns.GetInteraction(ctx, job.Request.DialogID, job.Request.ReplyToMessageID, job.Request.PersonalTeacherID)
	if err != nil {
		return true, err
	}
	if !known {
		return false, nil
	}
	return true, coordinator.processStaleText(ctx, job, interaction)
}

func (coordinator OnboardingCoordinator) Deliver(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob) error {
	if !coordinator.valid() || job.CoordinatorMode == "legacy" {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	turn, found, err := coordinator.Turns.GetTurn(ctx, job.TeacherJobID)
	if err != nil || !found || turn.Stage != domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnDeliveryPending || turn.ResponseCommandID == "" {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	response, err := domain.NewTeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse(domain.TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse{
		Mode: job.CoordinatorMode, Body: job.ResponseBody, AssistantUI: job.ResponseAssistantUI,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	message, err := coordinator.Appender.AppendTeacherCoordinatedResponse(ctx, job.Request, turn.ResponseCommandID, response)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	disposition, err := domain.ProductAwareOnboardingDeliveryDisposition(turn, len(job.ResponseAssistantUI) != 0)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	preserveActiveInteraction := disposition == domain.TeacherOnboardingDeliveryPreserve
	var next *domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction
	if disposition == domain.TeacherOnboardingDeliveryReplace {
		next, err = coordinator.nextDeliveredPromptInteraction(ctx, job, turn, message)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return coordinator.Deliveries.CompleteOnboardingDelivery(ctx, job.Request.EventID, job.ClaimToken, message.ID, next, preserveActiveInteraction, coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC())
}

// NeedsDelivery distinguishes a persisted semantic reply in a still-processing
// ai_staged turn from the final delivery_pending response. Both use the
// existing job.response_body, but only the latter may call Dialog append.
func (coordinator OnboardingCoordinator) NeedsDelivery(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob) (bool, error) {
	if !coordinator.valid() || job.CoordinatorMode == "legacy" {
		return false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	turn, found, err := coordinator.Turns.GetTurn(ctx, job.TeacherJobID)
	if err != nil || !found {
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		return false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	return turn.Stage == domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnDeliveryPending, nil
}

func (coordinator OnboardingCoordinator) processAction(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob) error {
	if coordinator.Receipts == nil {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	interaction, policyVersion, found, err := coordinator.currentInteraction(ctx, job)
	if err != nil || !found {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	receipt, receiptFound, err := coordinator.Receipts.Get(ctx, job.Request.ActionReceiptID)
	if err != nil || !receiptFound || !actionReceiptMatchesJob(receipt, job) {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	if interaction.State == domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved && interaction.ReservedTeacherJobID != job.TeacherJobID {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	interaction, err = coordinator.Turns.ReserveInteraction(ctx, interaction.ID, job.TeacherJobID, domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorAction, receipt.IdempotencyKey, coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	turn, _, err := coordinator.Turns.EnsureTurn(ctx, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn{
		TeacherJobID: job.TeacherJobID, SourceEventID: job.Request.EventID, InteractionID: interaction.ID,
		Mode: domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorAction, Stage: domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnReceived,
		// Dialog v2 intentionally does not carry a Student command ID. The
		// canonical receipt is the only trusted, immutable action source for it.
		ActionReceiptID: receipt.IdempotencyKey, StudentCommandID: receipt.StudentCommandID,
		ResponseCommandID:  domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("response", job.TeacherJobID),
		StudentEffectState: domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectNotAttempted, CreatedAt: coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC(), UpdatedAt: coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC(),
	}, job.ClaimToken)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if turn.Stage == domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnReceived {
		if err := coordinator.Turns.Advance(ctx, job.TeacherJobID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnReceived, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnInteractionReserved, domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectNotAttempted, "", "", coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		turn, _, err = coordinator.Turns.GetTurn(ctx, job.TeacherJobID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	switch turn.Stage {
	case domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnInteractionReserved:
		var command domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand
		var hasEffect bool
		var buildErr error
		if receipt.Step == domain.OnboardingStepConfirmation {
			proposal, found, proposalErr := coordinator.Turns.GetConfirmationProposal(ctx, interaction)
			if proposalErr != nil {
				return proposalErr
			}
			if !found {
				return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
			}
			command, hasEffect, buildErr = domain.BuildS5ConfirmedProposalTurn(job, interaction, receipt, proposal)
		} else {
			command, hasEffect, buildErr = domain.BuildS5DeterministicActionTurn(job, interaction, receipt)
		}
		if buildErr != nil {
			return buildErr
		}
		if !hasEffect {
			return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict // v1 finalization stays outside S5.
		}
		result, applyErr := coordinator.StudentTurns.ApplyTeacherOnboardingTurn(ctx, job.Request.StudentID, command)
		if applyErr != nil {
			// A timeout can be reconciled only by the exact receipt read. A 404
			// is unknown, not authorization to issue a no-effect proof.
			result, applyErr = coordinator.StudentTurns.GetTeacherOnboardingTurn(ctx, job.Request.StudentID, command.StudentCommandID)
			if applyErr != nil {
				return applyErr
			}
		}
		if result.StudentCommandID != command.StudentCommandID || result.CanonicalStudentMessageID != command.CanonicalStudentMessageID {
			return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
		effect := domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectAccepted
		proofID := ""
		if result.StudentEffectState == "no_effect" {
			effect = domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectNoEffect
			if result.NoEffectProofID == nil {
				return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
			}
			proofID = *result.NoEffectProofID
		}
		if err := coordinator.Turns.Advance(ctx, job.TeacherJobID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnInteractionReserved, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnStudentStaged, effect, proofID, "", coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		turn, _, err = coordinator.Turns.GetTurn(ctx, job.TeacherJobID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		fallthrough
	case domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnStudentStaged, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged:
		return coordinator.stageNextPrompt(ctx, job, turn, turn.StudentEffectState, policyVersion)
	case domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnDeliveryPending, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnDelivered:
		return nil
	default:
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
}

func (coordinator OnboardingCoordinator) processText(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob, interaction domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, policyVersion int) error {
	if coordinator.Semantic == nil {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	if interaction.State == domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved && interaction.ReservedTeacherJobID != job.TeacherJobID {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	interaction, err := coordinator.Turns.ReserveInteraction(ctx, interaction.ID, job.TeacherJobID, domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText, "", coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	turn, _, err := coordinator.Turns.EnsureTurn(ctx, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn{
		TeacherJobID: job.TeacherJobID, SourceEventID: job.Request.EventID, InteractionID: interaction.ID,
		Mode: domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText, Stage: domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnReceived,
		CausalAIExecutionID: domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("semantic-ai", job.TeacherJobID),
		StudentCommandID:    domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("semantic-student", job.TeacherJobID),
		ResponseCommandID:   domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("response", job.TeacherJobID),
		StudentEffectState:  domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectNotAttempted, CreatedAt: coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC(), UpdatedAt: coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC(),
	}, job.ClaimToken)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if turn.Stage == domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnReceived {
		if err := coordinator.Turns.Advance(ctx, job.TeacherJobID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnReceived, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnInteractionReserved, domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectNotAttempted, "", "", coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		turn, _, err = coordinator.Turns.GetTurn(ctx, job.TeacherJobID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	switch turn.Stage {
	case domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnInteractionReserved:
		if err := coordinator.Turns.Advance(ctx, job.TeacherJobID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnInteractionReserved, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnAIStaged, domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectNotAttempted, "", "", coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		turn, _, err = coordinator.Turns.GetTurn(ctx, job.TeacherJobID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		fallthrough
	case domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnAIStaged:
		decision, stagedTurn, semanticResponse, decisionErr := coordinator.ensureTextSemanticDecision(ctx, job, turn, interaction, policyVersion)
		if decisionErr != nil {
			return decisionErr
		}
		turn = stagedTurn
		if decision.Kind != domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionMutation {
			return coordinator.stageTextResponse(ctx, job, turn, interaction, decision, semanticResponse, policyVersion)
		}
		var command domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand
		var commandErr error
		if policyVersion == domain.TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2 {
			command, commandErr = domain.BuildProductAwareInterpretedTextTurn(job, turn, interaction, decision)
		} else if decision.Candidate != nil {
			command, commandErr = domain.BuildS5InterpretedTextTurn(job, turn, interaction, *decision.Candidate)
		} else {
			commandErr = domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
		if commandErr != nil {
			return commandErr
		}
		result, applyErr := coordinator.StudentTurns.ApplyTeacherOnboardingTurn(ctx, job.Request.StudentID, command)
		if applyErr != nil {
			result, applyErr = coordinator.StudentTurns.GetTeacherOnboardingTurn(ctx, job.Request.StudentID, command.StudentCommandID)
			if applyErr != nil {
				return applyErr
			}
		}
		if result.StudentCommandID != command.StudentCommandID || result.CanonicalStudentMessageID != command.CanonicalStudentMessageID {
			return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
		effect := domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectAccepted
		proofID := ""
		if result.StudentEffectState == "no_effect" {
			effect = domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectNoEffect
			if result.NoEffectProofID == nil {
				return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
			}
			proofID = *result.NoEffectProofID
		}
		if err := coordinator.Turns.Advance(ctx, job.TeacherJobID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnAIStaged, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnStudentStaged, effect, proofID, "", coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		turn, _, err = coordinator.Turns.GetTurn(ctx, job.TeacherJobID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return coordinator.stageTextResponse(ctx, job, turn, interaction, decision, semanticResponse, policyVersion)
	case domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnStudentStaged, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged:
		if turn.SemanticDecision == nil {
			return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
		semanticResponse, responseErr := coordinator.Turns.SaveSemanticDecision(ctx, job.TeacherJobID, job.ClaimToken, *turn.SemanticDecision, "", coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC())
		if responseErr != nil {
			return responseErr
		}
		return coordinator.stageTextResponse(ctx, job, turn, interaction, *turn.SemanticDecision, semanticResponse, policyVersion)
	case domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnDeliveryPending, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnDelivered:
		return nil
	default:
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
}

// processStaleText consumes a reply that targets a known but no-longer-current
// prompt. It must not run generic chat or an LLM: the response is a durable,
// deterministic warning and leaves the current interaction untouched.
func (coordinator OnboardingCoordinator) processStaleText(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob, interaction domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction) error {
	turn, _, err := coordinator.Turns.EnsureTurn(ctx, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn{
		TeacherJobID: job.TeacherJobID, SourceEventID: job.Request.EventID,
		Mode: domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText, Stage: domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnReceived,
		CausalAIExecutionID: domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("semantic-ai", job.TeacherJobID),
		StudentCommandID:    domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("semantic-student", job.TeacherJobID),
		ResponseCommandID:   domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("response", job.TeacherJobID),
		StudentEffectState:  domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectNotAttempted,
		CreatedAt:           coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC(), UpdatedAt: coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC(),
	}, job.ClaimToken)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if turn.Stage == domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnReceived {
		if err = coordinator.Turns.Advance(ctx, job.TeacherJobID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnReceived, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged, domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectNotAttempted, "", "", coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		turn, _, err = coordinator.Turns.GetTurn(ctx, job.TeacherJobID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if turn.Stage != domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged && turn.Stage != domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnDeliveryPending && turn.Stage != domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnDelivered {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	if turn.Stage == domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged {
		body := "Этот ответ относится к уже завершённому вопросу. Пожалуйста, используйте текущий вопрос."
		if interaction.State == domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionActive || interaction.State == domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved {
			body = "Пожалуйста, ответьте на текущий вопрос — предыдущее сообщение больше не активно."
		}
		return coordinator.Jobs.SaveCoordinatedResponse(ctx, job.Request.EventID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse{
			Mode: string(domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText), Body: body,
		}, coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC())
	}
	return nil
}

func (coordinator OnboardingCoordinator) ensureTextSemanticDecision(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob, turn domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn, interaction domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, policyVersion int) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn, string, error) {
	if turn.SemanticDecision != nil {
		response, err := coordinator.Turns.SaveSemanticDecision(ctx, job.TeacherJobID, job.ClaimToken, *turn.SemanticDecision, "", coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC())
		return *turn.SemanticDecision, turn, response, err
	}
	execution, err := coordinator.interpretText(ctx, job, turn, interaction, policyVersion)
	if err != nil {
		// A known expired/missing execution has no Student effect because the
		// decision has not been committed yet. Preserve the active prompt and
		// emit a deterministic clarification rather than reusing its key.
		if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticUnknown) {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn{}, "", err
		}
		state, stateErr := coordinator.Students.GetTeacherOnboardingState(ctx, job.Request.StudentID)
		if stateErr != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn{}, "", stateErr
		}
		body := "Не удалось надёжно разобрать ответ. Пожалуйста, выберите вариант в текущем вопросе."
		if domain.OnboardingLocale(state.Draft) == "en" {
			body = "I could not safely interpret that answer. Please choose an option in the current question."
		}
		execution.Result, stateErr = domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticResult(domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{
			Schema: domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticSchemaCode, Response: body,
			SlotCandidates: []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate{}, Questions: []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestion{}, Uncertainties: []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticUncertainty{},
		})
		if stateErr != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn{}, "", stateErr
		}
	}
	var decision domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision
	var decisionErr error
	if policyVersion == domain.TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2 {
		state, stateErr := coordinator.Students.GetTeacherOnboardingState(ctx, job.Request.StudentID)
		if stateErr != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn{}, "", stateErr
		}
		decision, decisionErr = domain.NewProductAwareTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision(execution.Result, interaction, state)
	} else {
		decision, decisionErr = domain.NewTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision(execution.Result, interaction)
	}
	if decisionErr != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn{}, "", decisionErr
	}
	semanticResponse, saveErr := coordinator.Turns.SaveSemanticDecision(ctx, job.TeacherJobID, job.ClaimToken, decision, execution.Result.Response, coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC())
	if saveErr != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn{}, "", saveErr
	}
	staged, found, getErr := coordinator.Turns.GetTurn(ctx, job.TeacherJobID)
	if getErr != nil || !found || staged.SemanticDecision == nil || staged.SemanticDecision.Digest != decision.Digest {
		if getErr != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn{}, "", getErr
		}
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision{}, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn{}, "", domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	return *staged.SemanticDecision, staged, semanticResponse, nil
}

func (coordinator OnboardingCoordinator) stageNextPrompt(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob, turn domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn, effect domain.TeacherOnboardingStudentEffectState, policyVersion int) error {
	if policyVersion == domain.TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2 && effect == domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectAccepted {
		return coordinator.stageProductAwareResponse(ctx, job, turn)
	}
	if policyVersion == domain.TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2 && effect == domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectNoEffect {
		if turn.Stage == domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnStudentStaged {
			if err := coordinator.Turns.Advance(ctx, job.TeacherJobID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnStudentStaged, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged, effect, turn.NoEffectProofID, "", coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		} else if turn.Stage != domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged {
			return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
		return coordinator.Jobs.SaveCoordinatedResponse(ctx, job.Request.EventID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse{
			Mode: string(turn.Mode), Body: "Этот выбор не изменил данные. Пожалуйста, ответьте на текущий вопрос ещё раз.",
		}, coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC())
	}
	state, err := coordinator.Students.GetTeacherOnboardingState(ctx, job.Request.StudentID)
	if err != nil || state.Draft.Status != domain.StudentOnboardingDraftDraft {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	step, err := domain.NextTeacherOnboardingStep(state.Draft)
	if err != nil || step == domain.OnboardingStepComplete {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	body, ui, err := domain.BuildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(step, domain.OnboardingLocale(state.Draft), state.Draft.Version)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if turn.Stage == domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnStudentStaged {
		if err := coordinator.Turns.Advance(ctx, job.TeacherJobID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnStudentStaged, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged, effect, turn.NoEffectProofID, "", coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	} else if turn.Stage != domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	if err := coordinator.Jobs.SaveCoordinatedResponse(ctx, job.Request.EventID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse{Mode: string(domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorAction), Body: body, AssistantUI: ui}, coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func (coordinator OnboardingCoordinator) stageProductAwareResponse(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob, turn domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn) error {
	if coordinator.Readiness == nil || coordinator.ProductResponses == nil || turn.Stage != domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnStudentStaged || turn.StudentEffectState != domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectAccepted {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	stateRef, state, err := coordinator.recoverAcceptedStudentState(ctx, job, turn)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	readiness, err := coordinator.Readiness.ResolveLearningReadiness(ctx, job.Request.StudentID, stateRef)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessStale) {
		// A 409 is reconciled only through the immutable Student command
		// receipt. If authoritative state still equals that receipt, repeat the
		// same pure read once; otherwise block without advancing the cursor.
		stateRef, state, err = coordinator.recoverAcceptedStudentState(ctx, job, turn)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		readiness, err = coordinator.Readiness.ResolveLearningReadiness(ctx, job.Request.StudentID, stateRef)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	plan, err := domain.BuildTeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan(readiness, state, job.Request.StudentID, domain.OnboardingLocale(state.Draft))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	sourceInteraction, found, err := coordinator.Turns.GetInteraction(ctx, job.Request.DialogID, job.Request.ReplyToMessageID, job.Request.PersonalTeacherID)
	if err != nil || !found || sourceInteraction.ID != turn.InteractionID {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	if sourceInteraction.SessionSchemaVersion == 3 && plan.Status == domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionPlanningReady {
		if coordinator.Handoffs == nil || readiness.Goal == nil || turn.InteractionID == "" {
			return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
		}
		binding, bindingErr := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(domain.TeacherDialogBinding{
			ID: job.Request.DialogID, StudentID: job.Request.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: job.Request.PersonalTeacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral,
		})
		if bindingErr != nil {
			return bindingErr
		}
		intent, intentErr := domain.BuildTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(domain.PersonalTeacher{ID: job.Request.PersonalTeacherID, StudentID: job.Request.StudentID}, binding, readiness, domain.OnboardingLocale(state.Draft), job.TeacherJobID, turn.InteractionID, coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC())
		if intentErr != nil {
			return intentErr
		}
		_, _, enqueueErr := coordinator.Handoffs.Enqueue(ctx, repository.TeacherOnboardingHandoffEnqueue{
			Intent: intent, EventID: job.Request.EventID, ClaimToken: job.ClaimToken,
		}, coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC())
		return enqueueErr
	}
	return coordinator.ProductResponses.StageProductAwareOnboardingResponse(ctx, job.Request.EventID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse{
		Mode: string(turn.Mode), Body: plan.Body, AssistantUI: plan.AssistantUI,
	}, coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC())
}

func (coordinator OnboardingCoordinator) recoverAcceptedStudentState(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob, turn domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn) (domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef, domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState, error) {
	receipt, err := coordinator.StudentTurns.GetTeacherOnboardingTurn(ctx, job.Request.StudentID, turn.StudentCommandID)
	if err != nil || receipt.StudentCommandID != turn.StudentCommandID || receipt.CanonicalStudentMessageID != job.Request.CanonicalStudentMessageID ||
		receipt.StudentEffectState != "accepted" || receipt.ResultDraftVersion == nil || *receipt.ResultDraftVersion < 1 || receipt.NoEffectProofID != nil {
		if err != nil {
			return domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{}, domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState{}, err
		}
		return domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{}, domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	stateRef := domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: *receipt.ResultDraftVersion}
	state, err := coordinator.Students.GetTeacherOnboardingState(ctx, job.Request.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{}, domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState{}, err
	}
	currentRef, err := domain.TeacherReadinessStateRefFromOnboarding(state, job.Request.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{}, domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState{}, err
	}
	if currentRef != stateRef {
		advanceErr := coordinator.Turns.Advance(ctx, job.TeacherJobID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnStudentStaged, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnBlockedUnknown, domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectCommittedUnreconciled, "", "", coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC())
		if advanceErr != nil {
			return domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{}, domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState{}, advanceErr
		}
		return domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{}, domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	return stateRef, state, nil
}

func (coordinator OnboardingCoordinator) interpretText(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob, turn domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn, interaction domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, policyVersion int) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution, error) {
	contextValue, err := coordinator.DialogReader.GetTeacherRequestContext(ctx, job.Request, 49)
	if err != nil || len(contextValue.Messages) == 0 {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	source := contextValue.Messages[len(contextValue.Messages)-1]
	var prompt *domain.DialogMessage
	for index := range contextValue.Messages {
		if contextValue.Messages[index].ID == interaction.PromptMessageID {
			prompt = &contextValue.Messages[index]
			break
		}
	}
	if prompt == nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	state, err := coordinator.Students.GetTeacherOnboardingState(ctx, job.Request.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{}, err
	}
	if policyVersion == domain.TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2 && interaction.SlotCode == domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection {
		normalizedText := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(source.Body))
		if normalizedText == "не знаю" || normalizedText == "не уверен" || normalizedText == "не уверена" || normalizedText == "i don't know" || normalizedText == "not sure" {
			result, resultErr := domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticResult(domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{
				Schema: domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticSchemaCode, Response: "Спасибо, начнём с основ.",
				SlotCandidates: []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate{{Slot: domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection, CodeValue: "undecided", StringListValue: []string{}, ConfidenceBasisPoints: 10000}},
				Questions:      []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestion{}, Uncertainties: []domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticUncertainty{},
			})
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{Result: result, LanguageCode: domain.OnboardingLocale(state.Draft), TemplateVersion: 1}, resultErr
		}
	}
	request, err := domain.BuildS5TextSemanticRequest(job, turn, interaction, state, source, *prompt)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{}, err
	}
	execution, err := coordinator.Semantic.InterpretOnboardingSemantic(ctx, request)
	if err == nil {
		return execution, nil
	}
	// A transport acknowledgement can be ambiguous. Reconciliation is always
	// by the same caller-issued key; an unknown GET is not a no-effect proof and
	// leaves the job retryable with that same immutable semantic binding.
	if execution, replayErr := coordinator.Semantic.ReplayOnboardingSemantic(ctx, turn.CausalAIExecutionID); replayErr == nil {
		return execution, nil
	}
	return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{}, err
}

func (coordinator OnboardingCoordinator) stageTextResponse(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob, turn domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn, interaction domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, decision domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision, semanticResponse string, policyVersion int) error {
	if turn.Mode != domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText || turn.InteractionID != interaction.ID ||
		(turn.Stage != domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnAIStaged && turn.Stage != domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnStudentStaged && turn.Stage != domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged) {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	// The persisted decision deliberately contains no provider wording.  These
	// server-owned replies make recovery deterministic without retaining the
	// raw semantic result; the final body itself exists only in the staged job
	// and then Dialog history.
	response := domain.TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse{Mode: string(domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText), Body: "Спасибо, учту ваш ответ. Продолжим."}
	switch turn.StudentEffectState {
	case domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectAccepted:
		// An accepted S3 effect is only valid for the exact low-risk candidate
		// selected before the Apply call. A replayed AI result may never turn a
		// previously staged Student effect into a different response/UI path.
		if decision.Kind != domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionMutation || (decision.Candidate == nil && len(decision.Candidates) == 0) {
			return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
		if policyVersion == domain.TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2 {
			return coordinator.stageProductAwareResponse(ctx, job, turn)
		}
		state, err := coordinator.Students.GetTeacherOnboardingState(ctx, job.Request.StudentID)
		if err != nil || state.Draft.Status != domain.StudentOnboardingDraftDraft || state.Draft.Version <= interaction.ExpectedDraftVersion {
			return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
		step, err := domain.NextTeacherOnboardingStep(state.Draft)
		if err != nil || step == domain.OnboardingStepComplete {
			return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
		body, ui, err := domain.BuildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(step, domain.OnboardingLocale(state.Draft), state.Draft.Version)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		response.Body, response.AssistantUI = body, ui
	case domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectNoEffect:
		// A no-effect receipt is still tied to the exact deterministic S3
		// command. It cannot be reused to acknowledge a response-only model
		// result, otherwise a later replay could hide a different attempted
		// mutation behind the same Teacher turn.
		if decision.Kind != domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionMutation ||
			(decision.Candidate == nil && len(decision.Candidates) == 0) {
			return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
	case domain.TeacherOnboardingEffectNotAttempted:
		if policyVersion == domain.TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2 && decision.Kind == domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionResponseOnly {
			response.Body = "Не удалось надёжно связать ответ с текущим вопросом. Пожалуйста, ответьте на него ещё раз."
		} else if decision.Kind == domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionResponseOnly && semanticResponse != "" {
			response.Body = semanticResponse
		} else {
			response.Body = "Давайте уточним ответ в текущем вопросе."
		}
		if decision.Kind == domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionMutation {
			return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
		if decision.Kind == domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionConfirmation {
			state, err := coordinator.Students.GetTeacherOnboardingState(ctx, job.Request.StudentID)
			if err != nil || state.Draft.Status != domain.StudentOnboardingDraftDraft || state.Draft.Version != interaction.ExpectedDraftVersion || state.ProfileVersion != interaction.ExpectedProfileVersion {
				return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
			}
			var body string
			var ui []byte
			var buildErr error
			if policyVersion == domain.TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2 {
				body, ui, buildErr = domain.BuildProductAwareTeacherOnboardingPrompt(domain.OnboardingStepConfirmation, domain.OnboardingLocale(state.Draft), state.Draft.Version)
			} else {
				body, ui, buildErr = domain.BuildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(domain.OnboardingStepConfirmation, domain.OnboardingLocale(state.Draft), state.Draft.Version)
			}
			if buildErr != nil {
				return buildErr
			}
			response.Body, response.AssistantUI = body, ui
		}
	default:
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	if turn.Stage != domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged {
		if err := coordinator.Turns.Advance(ctx, job.TeacherJobID, job.ClaimToken, turn.Stage, domain.TeacherOnboardingTurnResponseStaged, turn.StudentEffectState, turn.NoEffectProofID, "", coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return coordinator.Jobs.SaveCoordinatedResponse(ctx, job.Request.EventID, job.ClaimToken, response, coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC())
}

func (coordinator OnboardingCoordinator) currentInteraction(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob) (domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, int, bool, error) {
	contextValue, err := coordinator.DialogReader.GetTeacherRequestContext(ctx, job.Request, 49)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, 0, false, err
	}
	if len(contextValue.Messages) == 0 {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, 0, false, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	source := contextValue.Messages[len(contextValue.Messages)-1]
	if source.ID != job.Request.SourceMessageID || source.ReplyToMessageID != job.Request.ReplyToMessageID || source.Status != 1 {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, 0, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	if source.Version != int(job.Request.SourceMessageVersion) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, 0, false, errKnownOnboardingStale
	}
	interaction, found, err := coordinator.Turns.GetActiveInteraction(ctx, job.Request.DialogID, job.Request.ReplyToMessageID, job.Request.PersonalTeacherID)
	if err != nil || !found {
		return interaction, 0, found, err
	}
	var prompt *domain.DialogMessage
	for index := range contextValue.Messages {
		if contextValue.Messages[index].ID == interaction.PromptMessageID {
			prompt = &contextValue.Messages[index]
			break
		}
	}
	if prompt == nil || prompt.AuthorType != domain.DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher || prompt.Status != 1 || prompt.Version != int(interaction.PromptMessageVersion) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, 0, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	digest, digestErr := domain.DigestTeacherAssistantUI(prompt.AssistantUI)
	if digestErr != nil || digest != interaction.PromptAssistantUIDigest {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, 0, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	policyVersion, policyErr := domain.TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyVersion(prompt.AssistantUI)
	if policyErr != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, 0, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	return interaction, policyVersion, true, nil
}

func (coordinator OnboardingCoordinator) nextDeliveredPromptInteraction(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob, turn domain.TeacherOnboardingTurn, message domain.DialogMessage) (*domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, error) {
	if len(message.AssistantUI) == 0 {
		return nil, nil
	}
	sourceInteraction, found, err := coordinator.Turns.GetInteraction(ctx, job.Request.DialogID, job.Request.ReplyToMessageID, job.Request.PersonalTeacherID)
	if err != nil || !found || sourceInteraction.ID != turn.InteractionID {
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return nil, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	interactionSessionSchemaVersion := sourceInteraction.SessionSchemaVersion
	state, err := coordinator.Students.GetTeacherOnboardingState(ctx, job.Request.StudentID)
	if err != nil || state.Draft.Status != domain.StudentOnboardingDraftDraft {
		return nil, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	step, policyVersion, err := domain.TeacherOnboardingPromptStep(message.AssistantUI)
	if err != nil || step == domain.OnboardingStepComplete {
		return nil, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	binding, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(domain.TeacherDialogBinding{ID: job.Request.DialogID, StudentID: job.Request.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: job.Request.PersonalTeacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if turn.Mode == domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText && turn.SemanticDecision != nil && turn.SemanticDecision.Kind == domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticDecisionConfirmation {
		if step != domain.OnboardingStepConfirmation || (turn.SemanticDecision.PolicyVersion == domain.TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2) != (policyVersion == domain.TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2) {
			return nil, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
		interaction, confirmationErr := domain.NewS5ConfirmationInteractionForResponse(binding, message, job.Request.SourceMessageID, *turn.SemanticDecision, state.Draft.Version, state.ProfileVersion, interactionSessionSchemaVersion, coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC())
		if confirmationErr != nil {
			return nil, confirmationErr
		}
		return &interaction, nil
	}
	if policyVersion == domain.TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV1 {
		expectedStep, stepErr := domain.NextTeacherOnboardingStep(state.Draft)
		if stepErr != nil || expectedStep != step {
			return nil, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
	}
	interaction, err := domain.NewS5OnboardingInteractionForResponse(binding, message, job.Request.SourceMessageID, step, state.Draft.Version, state.ProfileVersion, interactionSessionSchemaVersion, coordinator.Clock.Now().UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &interaction, nil
}

func (coordinator OnboardingCoordinator) valid() bool {
	// A canonical action must stay deterministic and available without an AI
	// Prompt client. The text branch checks Semantic explicitly before it can
	// issue its one semantic execution.
	return coordinator.Jobs != nil && coordinator.Turns != nil && coordinator.StudentTurns != nil && coordinator.Students != nil && coordinator.DialogReader != nil && coordinator.Appender != nil && coordinator.Deliveries != nil && coordinator.Clock != nil
}

func eligibleS5OnboardingRequest(request domain.DialogTeacherRequest) bool {
	return request.UsesDenseTeacherOrdering() && request.ContextType == domain.LearningContextGeneral && request.LearningActionID == "" && request.HasFrozenOnboardingReplyMetadata()
}

func actionReceiptMatchesJob(receipt domain.OnboardingActionReceipt, job domain.TeacherDialogJob) bool {
	return receipt.IdempotencyKey == job.Request.ActionReceiptID && receipt.ExecutionMode == domain.OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical && receipt.Status == domain.OnboardingReceiptMaterialized &&
		receipt.StudentID == job.Request.StudentID && receipt.PersonalTeacherID == job.Request.PersonalTeacherID && receipt.DialogID == job.Request.DialogID &&
		receipt.CanonicalStudentMessageID == job.Request.CanonicalStudentMessageID && receipt.CanonicalStudentMessageID == job.Request.SourceMessageID &&
		receipt.SourceMessageID == job.Request.ReplyToMessageID && receipt.SourceMessageVersion > 0
}

var _ UnifiedOnboardingCoordinator = OnboardingCoordinator{}
